integrity: The boundary enumeration, each subset-sum witness, and minimality against every smaller subset cardinality are replayed exactly with integer arithmetic by the packaged checker. Broader finite-window literature already covers existence with seven negative signs, so the claimed contribution is the sharper exact spectrum and extremizers.
limitations: The result is restricted to odd nondeficient integers with \(\Omega(n)=5\). It does not extend the five-negative bound to larger total multiplicity. The finite spectrum is exhaustive only because symbolic abundancy bounds make all prime ranges finite.
title: Signed-divisor complexity on the first odd nondeficient layer \(\Omega(n)=5\)
